summary: Iran has conducted cruise missile and drone strikes against shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, wounding at least 8 US Marines aboard a ship, while the IRGC claims to have attacked 19 vessels. Netanyahu made a secret visit to Abu Dhabi to meet UAE President MBZ, deepening military-political integration amid the US-Israeli war on Iran. IDF continues eliminating Hamas commanders in Gaza as heavy artillery and airstrikes hit Lebanon and armed clashes erupt in northern Iraq.
key_points: Iran struck a ship in the Strait of Hormuz with a cruise missile, wounding 8 US Marines two weeks ago, per NBC News citing American officials (Source: @sharghdaily/186192).

Netanyahu made an unannounced secret visit to Abu Dhabi to meet UAE President MBZ, highlighting accelerating military and political integration between Israel and the UAE amid the US-Israeli war on Iran (Source: @presstv/208608).
IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Muhammad Muhammad Ghaibi, Hamas military wing commander, who was involved in holding hostages including Ziv Berman, Eitan Mor, and others (Source: @almogboker78/18280).
The IRGC claims to have attacked 19 ships overnight, while Trump stated he is 'thinking about another attack' (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81600).
Heavy and unusual continuous artillery shelling struck Wadi Zabqeen and Wadi Salouqi in Lebanon, alongside fighter jet activity in southern Lebanon (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/395537).
Armed clashes in Duhok province, northern Iraq, resulted in at least 15 injuries in initial reports (Source: @naya_foriraq/91804).
Iran's IRGC spokesperson stated Americans are not in a good position in the region and that Iran is more prepared than ever to respond to any US aggression (Source: @VahidOnline/78544).
IDF eliminated Hamas sniper Adi Adla Abd al-Azzar in southern Gaza Strip to remove an immediate threat, striking him from the air (Source: @idf_telegram/25235).
Israeli far-right Minister Ben-Gvir threatened Palestinian prisoner Hassan Salameh with execution, saying 'I want to kill you' (Source: @presstv/208609).
Iraq is reportedly seeking a US exemption to allow Iraqi airlines to resume flights to Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/92577).
Tehran-Najaf flights are set to resume from Wednesday after a ban was lifted, per Iraqi media (Source: @sharghdaily/186190).
Three ballistic missiles were reported inbound toward the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/10517).
USAF combat air patrols reportedly downed multiple UAVs over the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/10518).
Iran's National TV Channel 3 threatened regional aviation (Source: @shin_persian/10522).
Analysts report British bombers may soon arrive to conduct strikes on Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/92587).
US Treasury Secretary Bessent stated Iran will likely exhaust its last oil shipments to China within two weeks, after which it will have nothing to exchange (Source: @mamlekate/104663).
An explosion was reported in NW Jordan with unknown cause, pending further information (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7590).
Iran's deputy FM condemned US Treasury attempts to dictate global trade, saying the era of Washington imposing its will through threats is ending (Source: @presstv/208611).
Major General Yahya Rahim Safavi stated the US is on its way out of West Asia and Iran will determine the region's future security arrangements (Source: @presstv/208607).
Iran's Pezeshkian addressed the UN General Assembly, defending Iran's right to peaceful nuclear technology and stating Iran will not shy away from negotiations (Source: @sharghdaily/186191).
Iran's delegation in New York has no plans for a new round of negotiations with the US, awaiting American response (Source: @sharghdaily/186183).
Netherlands revoked Israeli diplomatic documentation after entering force of a ban on importing products from Israel, East Jerusalem, and the Golan Heights (Source: @amitsegal/65225).
The IRGC marked the second anniversary of Nasrallah's martyrdom, declaring his legacy a 'fountain of power' for the Axis of Resistance (Source: @presstv/208614).
Heavy artillery shelling struck Zouatra East and fighter jets were reported heading south over Lebanon (Source: @redlinkleb/45614).
Trump declined to answer whether the US would strike Iran before midterm elections, saying only 'Don't want to say' (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7582).
President Trump mentioned considering invoking the Defense Production Act to expand US refining capacity amid Iran-war-driven fuel costs (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7582).
Saudi Arabia and Iran are negotiating Hajj flight arrangements, with efforts to begin dispatching pilgrims from the second half of Mehr month (Source: @sharghdaily/186184).
IDF spokesperson stated forces in the South Command are deployed across the area per the agreement and will continue operating to remove all immediate threats (Source: @idf_telegram/25235).
A child was seen entering a building where Hamas operatives were active in Gaza (Source: @amitsegal/65211).
Lebanon clarified that aviation heard over Beirut and Mount Lebanon is civilian, not military (Source: @redlinkleb/45658).
Machine gun sweeps and enemy mechanized movements were reported near Ghadaba in Lebanon (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/395542).
Six fuel-supply aircraft were reported flying near the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81599).
Iran's President Pezeshkian's UN speech drew praise from domestic factions who are typically critical of government policies (Source: @sharghdaily/186191).
Tasnim analysts criticized Pezeshkian's diplomatic approach, questioning why negotiation is seen as the solution (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81598).

The IRGC spokesperson stated that if the US situation were favorable, they would not be attempting to change it, and that the US may commit aggression but Iran is more prepared than in the past (Source: @VahidOnline/78544).
South Korea agreed to keep the transfer of North Korean war prisoners secret due to security and diplomatic concerns (Source: @naya_foriraq/91808).

sections.executive_summary: Iran has escalated maritime attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, with cruise missile strikes wounding at least 8 US Marines and the IRGC claiming attacks on 19 vessels, while the US considers further strikes against Iran. Netanyahu made a secret visit to Abu Dhabi to deepen Israel-UAE military integration amid the broader US-Israeli war on Iran. IDF continues targeted killings of Hamas commanders in Gaza while heavy artillery and airstrikes intensify across Lebanon and armed clashes erupt in northern Iraq.
iran: Iran conducted cruise missile strikes on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz, wounding 8 US Marines aboard, per NBC News citing American officials (Source: @sharghdaily/186192).
The IRGC claims to have attacked 19 ships overnight, as reported in live broadcasts linking Trump to considering another attack (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81600).

Iran's IRGC spokesperson Mohammad Akrami-Nia stated Americans are not in a good position in the region and that Iran is more prepared than ever to respond to any US aggression, saying 'the US may commit aggression but we are more prepared than before' (Source: @VahidOnline/78544).
Iran's National TV Channel 3 threatened regional aviation, according to reports with English subtitles (Source: @shin_persian/10522).
Iran's delegation in New York has no plans for a new round of negotiations with the US, with the foreign minister expected to return home after scheduled programs (Source: @sharghdaily/186183).

US Treasury Secretary Bessent stated Iran will likely exhaust its last oil shipments to China within two weeks, after which it will have nothing to exchange, and that Beijing has significantly reduced assistance to the Islamic Republic (Source: @mamlekate/104663).

Iran's President Pezeshkian addressed the UN General Assembly defending Iran's right to peaceful nuclear technology and stating Iran will not shy away from negotiations, drawing praise from domestic factions typically critical of government policies (Source: @sharghdaily/186191).
Analysts report British bombers may soon arrive to conduct strikes on Iran, according to sources cited by kianmeli1 (Source: @kianmeli1/92587).

Major General Yahya Rahim Safavi, senior military adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader, stated the US is on its way out of West Asia and Iran will determine the region's future security arrangements (Source: @presstv/208607).

Iran's deputy FM condemned US Treasury Secretary's admission of dispatching envoys worldwide to pressure countries into cutting economic ties with Tehran, declaring the era of Washington imposing its will through threats is ending (Source: @presstv/208611).
Iran is reportedly seeking a US exemption to allow Iraqi airlines to resume flights to Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/92577).
Tehran-Najaf flights are set to resume from Wednesday after a ban was reportedly lifted, per Iraqi media sources (Source: @sharghdaily/186190).
Three ballistic missiles were reported inbound toward the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/10517).

The IRGC marked the second anniversary of Nasrallah's martyrdom, declaring his legacy a 'fountain of power' for the Axis of Resistance and that his strategic vision continues to guide the fight against US and Israeli aggression (Source: @presstv/208614).
Patriot defense systems have been widely transferred to the Middle East, according to reports (Source: @kianmeli1/92592).

IDF eliminated Hamas sniper Adi Adla Abd al-Azzar in southern Gaza Strip from the air to remove an immediate threat, as the soldier had been advancing terrorist plans and systematically violating the ceasefire (Source: @idf_telegram/25235).

Netanyahu made an unannounced, highly secretive visit to Abu Dhabi to meet UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, highlighting accelerating military and political integration between the two regimes (Source: @presstv/208608).
